notes.title: Free To Play (April 6th)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Sphere frustration is changing to free to play on the 6th of april. Thank you to those of you who have already purchased sphere frustration, you will not be forgotten with this change.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
The Free to play version will contain all the current content with exception to the seasonal updates.

Originally the seasonal content was going to be removed after the specific seasonal period ended, but the content was left in the game [i](Winter Survival and The ghostly Household)[/i].

With this free to play change, the seasonal content will be moved to paid DLC. 

[h1]PAID DLC[/h1]
There will only be 1 DLC pack and it will be priced at $1 , the price of the game before the change to free to play. 

The DLC pack will include the seasonal content, but to furthur reward players who purchase, any furthur maps/modes released will be added to this dlc. 

[h1]ALREADY OWN THE GAME[/h1]
If you already own the game. You will keep all current content [i](seasonal)[/i] and receive any additional content that is added to the DLC pack in future updates.

Feedback is most welcome.

notes.title: Winter Update - 1.3
notes.content:
3 winter arena's now available in the new "Winter Survival" game mode.

Contains 2 modified arena's and 1 new arena. 

[b]Collect all the gifts, avoid the human! [/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389904/e683ad367d27baaa883931e927216f853c0cb75b.png[/img]
Winter Survival is playable via;
[i]Single Player > Survival > Winter Survival[/i]

Like the update? , Want to see more winter maps?
Let me know.

-
Any Problems, let me know.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Challenge Mode Added
notes.content:
New challenge game mode now available for single player.

More frustration, not only must you avoid the human chasing you, you must now collect the items before your opponent does. 

Challenge mode currently contains 2 arena's with 3 possible difficulty settings.

Feedback is most welcome.
